scope: Journal Explorer only; not a certification of other research apps or error-free upstream metadata.

corpus.scope: All Explorer aggregates and displayed paper examples replayed against saved Research Book inputs. This establishes derivation, not independent confirmation that provider metadata is error-free.

publisherReview.method: Reviewed primary publisher pages and linked calls using web source retrieval.
publisherReview.confirmed: JOB historical metrics, four submission windows and their distinct submission types, selected Early View status, current issue, editor and author instructions. The chronic-illness deadline and ARCDI page-limit discrepancies remain explicitly flagged.

correction.reason: Combined regex alternation missed overlapping topic phrases. Each topic is now searched independently.

limitations: Corpus verification proves exact derivation from saved provider-backed input files; it does not freshly verify every underlying record with a publisher.
Topic lenses are title-only heuristics, not validated constructs or statistical evidence of editorial demand.
Forecasts and proposed questions are AI-assisted suggestions; no topic-specific acceptance probabilities are estimated.
Phase durations and conditional completion dates are planning assumptions. Historical publisher medians are separately attributed.
Absent, null and empty title/relation fields from Crossref endpoints are equivalent missing data; the audit records these serialization differences.
